persistence_semantics.source_of_truth: this repository contract, not conversation memory
persistence_semantics.new_chat_instruction: When the user says 衡策掃一次, load this contract first and follow it without re-asking already-defined architecture or rerunning eliminated models.

scan_order: Q017 x V43 x W1 resonance layer

lane_roles.Q017: canonical decision gate and optional third ranking/selection signal
lane_roles.V43: independent H20-style medium-horizon screening/research signal with zero Q017 write/order authority
lane_roles.X: frozen full-model research frontier; status only unless a current valid output already exists
lane_roles.E2: retired from current scan-once protocol; do not restore as a required scan lane unless a later contract explicitly reactivates it

grades.SS: Q017 explicit selection AND V43 Top3 AND W1 Top20
grades.A: with Q017 ranking: at least one hard lane and all three rank percentiles >= 85%; otherwise preserve V43/W1 A-grade only
grades.B: with Q017 ranking: all three rank percentiles >= 85%; otherwise preserve V43/W1 B-grade only
grades.C: with Q017 ranking: all three rank percentiles >= 80%; otherwise preserve V43/W1 C-grade only

canonical_gate.if_q017_cash: Research resonance may still be displayed, but canonical action must be CASH_BLOCKED.

resonance_policy.score_semantics: Reporting-only rank consensus. It must not change Q017, V43, or W1 model weights, thresholds, holding periods, costs, frontier metrics, or execution authority.

frozen_and_eliminated_rules.missing_current_output_rule: Report no current valid output; never rerun a frozen/eliminated model just to manufacture picks.

reporting_rules.weekend_rule: Do not pretend a weekend has a new trading signal; use the most recent valid signal date.
reporting_rules.q017_cash_rule: Explicitly show CASH / no canonical picks when Q017 is CASH.

authority.purpose: persistent scan orchestration and reporting semantics
